title: Startup GitHub Engineering Velocity Panel
subtitle: GitHub commit velocity across 55 venture-backed startups, 5 quarters
description:
Quarterly panel of GitHub engineering-velocity signals across 55 venture-backed startups. Covers 20 sectors and 5 quarters (Q2 2025 — Q3 2025 — Q4 2025 — Q1 2026 — Q2 2026) with 219 startup-period observations.

Collected by [VC Deal Flow Signal](https://gitdealflow.com) from the public GitHub REST API. Designed for venture-capital deal sourcing, academic research on open-source development patterns, and predictive modeling of startup funding events.

**DOI**: [10.5281/zenodo.19650920](https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.19650920)
**SSRN preprint**: https://ssrn.com/abstract=6606558
**Mirrors**: [Zenodo](https://zenodo.org/records/19650920) · [Data.world](https://data.world/thedatanerd2026/vc-deal-flow-signal-startup-engineering-acceleration)

**Files**
- `startup_signals.csv` — one row per startup per period (primary observation table, 219 rows).
- `sector_aggregates.csv` — sector-level aggregates per period.
- `signal_type_timeseries.csv` — distribution of signal types over time.
- `datapackage.json` — Frictionless Data schema (auto-parseable by downstream tools).
- `CITATION.cff` — machine-readable citation metadata.
- `README.md` / `LICENSE.txt` / `UPLOAD-GUIDE.md` / `LIVE-URLS.md` — documentation.
- `build.mjs` — generator script that emits the CSVs from the raw source.

**Signal types**
- Framework migration
- Engineering hiring burst
- Infrastructure buildout
- Deploy frequency spike

**Methodology**: https://signals.gitdealflow.com/methodology

**Citation**
> The Data Nerd. (2026). *A Longitudinal Panel of GitHub Engineering Velocity for Venture-Backed Startups: Dataset and Early Observations* (v1.0.0) [Data set]. Zenodo. https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.19650920
